{
  "project_id": "P-NGA-AgroProcessingLivelihood",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Macroeconomic instability and persistent oil price shocks could strain public revenues and private investment, reducing market demand for processed agricultural products.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Focus project investments on local food security crops and import-substituting value chains (rice, maize, cassava) that remain resilient during fiscal downturns.",
      "evidence": "Since the onset of the oil price shock in the mid-2014, growth declined from 6.3 percent in 2014 to 2.8 percent in 2015."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Militancy and regional security challenges in areas like the Niger Delta or North East could disrupt project execution, field visits, and supply chains.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate flexible allocation mechanisms to prioritize safer agricultural corridors and implement local community-based monitoring and stakeholder engagement strategies.",
      "evidence": "compounded by additional factors including a sharp drop in oil production levels due to militant activities in the Niger Delta region."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Inadequate financial documentation and unretired travel advances at FPFMD and state PFMUs could lead to ineligible expenditures or disbursement delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce an enhanced accountability framework in the Financial Procedures Manual, conduct risk-based internal audits, and mandate biannual external audit reviews.",
      "evidence": "The key issues noted within the PFMUs and FPFMD are unretired advances and inadequate documentation of the eligible expenditures incurred."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Weak procurement capacity and lack of standardized tools at the state level could cause procurement bottlenecks, delays, and non-compliance with World Bank guidelines.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Competitively hire dedicated procurement consultants at the NCO to provide continuous technical support, oversight, and capacity building to State Coordination Offices.",
      "evidence": "The procurement capacity is still considered low and most of the states do not have procurement tools in place."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Delays in negotiating, authorizing, or executing Subsidiary Agreements between the Federal Government and participating states could postpone project effectiveness and credit disbursements.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide early legal support and standardized subsidiary templates during project preparation to expedite state-level execution and legal opinion processing.",
      "evidence": "At least one Subsidiary Agreement has been executed on behalf of the Recipient and one Participating State and has been duly authorized or ratified"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "A significant drop in agricultural output prices (greater than 10-20%) could erode profitability, turning net present values negative and threatening enterprise viability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish formal off-take contracts and business alliances, while deploying commodity aggregation and storage facilities to smooth price volatility and prevent distress sales.",
      "evidence": "if benefits were reduced by 20 percent for all the crops, the net present values will turn negative while the IRR were also below the cost of capital."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Increased use of agro-chemicals and execution of small-scale civil works could pollute soil and water sources, generate waste, and degrade natural resources.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF) and Integrated Pest Management Plan (IPMP), ensuring rigorous screening and environmental audits.",
      "evidence": "support to sub-project infrastructure involving small-scale works, and agricultural intensification involving the use of inputs, could potentially have adverse impact on soil, water and vegetation covers."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Land acquisition for infrastructure support, aggregation centers, or agribusiness clusters could cause involuntary resettlement or restrict community access to common resources.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Screen sub-projects using the Resettlement Policy Framework (RPF) and prepare site-specific Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs) to ensure fair compensation and livelihood restoration.",
      "evidence": "infrastructure investments could result in involuntary re-settlement and land requisition."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Extension of utility lines, gas pipelines, or power infrastructure to processing clusters could encroach upon or fragment sensitive natural habitats like swamps and marshes.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply strict environmental screening checklists under OP/BP 4.04 to realign infrastructure routes away from critical natural habitats and wetlands.",
      "evidence": "installation of gas pipelines might pass through important natural habitats such as swamps and marshes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Prevalence of counterfeit or adulterated seeds, fertilizers, and agro-chemicals could suppress yield gains and damage farmer trust in demonstrated technologies.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Partner with regulatory bodies like NASC and FEPSAN to strengthen quality assurance, enforce input standards, and link farmers with accredited agro-dealers.",
      "evidence": "quality control of agro-inputs such as seeds, fertilizer and agro-chemicals to address issues of adulteration"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Socio-cultural constraints and unequal access to land, credit, and technical assets could prevent women and youth from fully participating in empowerment activities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Ring-fence dedicated sub-component funding for women and youth start-ups, deploy a gender tracker, and provide targeted mentorship and business planning support.",
      "evidence": "women in Nigeria, compared with men, have relatively limited access to productive agricultural land, inputs and services."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Complex multi-tiered governance involving both federal (NCO) and state (SCO) entities could lead to coordination friction, bureaucratic delays, and inconsistent oversight.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Standardize operational workflows using a comprehensive Project Implementation Manual (PIM) and convene regular National and State Steering Committee meetings.",
      "evidence": "Project implementation will involve both the federal and state governments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Inadequate funding or lack of defined user ownership could cause common aggregation centers, access roads, and processing utilities to deteriorate post-investment.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Require clear operational management structures and beneficiary O&M financing arrangements prior to committing project funds for infrastructure construction.",
      "evidence": "the project will first establish a management structure and O&M arrangement for each infrastructure before investing in such undertakings."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Farmers may resist adopting proposed climate-smart and nutrition-sensitive technologies due to risk aversion or lack of practical familiarity.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish hands-on technology demonstration plots, farmer field days, and peer-to-peer knowledge exchanges supported by research institutes and matching grants.",
      "evidence": "low level of technology adoption"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Commercial off-takers may breach off-take contracts or exploit weak farmer negotiation capacity, exposing smallholders to market and price risks.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide technical assistance to formalize clear business alliances, build cooperative negotiation skills, and utilize neutral third-party service providers for contract brokering.",
      "evidence": "weak market negotiation ability of small producers vis-à-vis buyers and input providers to obtain better prices"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Delays in establishing and fully staffing new State Coordination Offices (SCOs) in candidate states will delay disbursement eligibility and project rollout.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Leverage existing CADP project administrative structures in initial states while fast-tracking staff competitive recruitment in new states like Kogi.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawal shall be made under Categories (1), (2), and (3) ... unless the concerned Participating State has duly established its SCO"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Macroeconomic instability and persistent oil price shocks could strain public revenues and private investment, reducing market demand for processed agricultural products.
risks.mitigation: Focus project investments on local food security crops and import-substituting value chains (rice, maize, cassava) that remain resilient during fiscal downturns.
